changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0015. Membership plans, gym memberships, and membership history. Gym membership is the paid plan record, not TenantMembers. Index review: PK on each Id; UX plan name and membership number are unique per tenant; IX_GymMemberships_TenantId_Status_EndDate supports dashboard expiry; IX_GymMemberships_MemberProfileId supports a member's history; IX_MembershipHistory_GymMembershipId is the timeline read. Price uses DECIMAL(19,4). Performance note: list indexes lead with TenantId so a gym never scans another gym's memberships.
